dataset.role: Comparative chart benchmarks & pedagogical parameter uncertainty illustration

retail_consumption.model: Retail Sales YoY ~ Unemployment Rate (Contemporaneous Okun OLS)

methodological_distinctions.parameter_uncertainty: SE(beta) describes sampling standard deviation of coefficient estimators.
methodological_distinctions.conditional_mean_interval: mu_hat(x) +- t * s_e * sqrt(1/n + (x - x_bar)^2 / SS_xx). Uncertainty of the expected average response.
methodological_distinctions.forecast_prediction_interval: y_new +- t * s_e * sqrt(1 + 1/n + (x - x_bar)^2 / SS_xx). Substantially wider due to individual residual variance s_e^2.
methodological_distinctions.recession_logit_classification: Illustrative macro stress scoring formula. With only 4 recession events in N=16 non-consecutive years, it is NOT an out-of-sample validated probability model.
methodological_distinctions.lag_structure_limitation: Multi-year gaps (up to 5 years between 2010 and 2015) violate uniform annual lag assumptions (t -> t+1). Continuous annual series is required for valid dynamic lag estimation.
